characters.summary: Thanos relies on overwhelming physical strength, unmatched combat skill, and heavy military tactics. Armed with a double-edged sword, he defeats multiple skilled heroes simultaneously in hand-to-hand combat.

mechanisms: Extreme durability capable of surviving blows from Mjolnir and Stormbreaker

weaknesses: Vulnerable to having his arm severed or being overpowered when distracted
limitations: Lacks inherent supernatural powers or energy projection without external artifacts

sources.supports: Overview of MCU Thanos abilities, durability, and combat style.

feats.claim: Easily defeated the Hulk in unarmed combat.
Fought simultaneously against Iron Man, Captain America, and Thor, managing to overpower them.

notableResults.note: Overpowered Thor using raw physical force and chokeholds.
Defeated him quickly in a straight physical brawl.

unknowns: Exact limits of his durability without armor.

characters.continuity: Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) - Hypothetical/Comics crossover adaptation
characters.summary: Heart of the Universe Thanos possesses absolute omnipotence, control over all reality, and supreme cosmic power.

mechanisms: Absolute invulnerability derived from being one with the universe

characters.formDifferences: Grants absolute omnipotence, reality manipulation, and cosmic supremacy far exceeding the base character.

sources.supports: General reference to Thanos comic book power variants.

unknowns: The Heart of the Universe has not formally appeared or been detailed within the canonical MCU films.

characters.summary: Equipped with the Infinity Gauntlet, Thanos commands all six Infinity Stones, allowing him to manipulate reality, space, time, power, mind, and soul simultaneously with a snap of his fingers.

mechanisms: Energy shielding provided by the Infinity Stones

weaknesses: Severe physical trauma and radiation damage caused by channeling the combined power of all six Infinity Stones
limitations: Requires the physical gauntlet and stones to be intact
Using the full power of the stones causes catastrophic bodily harm
characters.formDifferences: Replaces his standard physical melee focus with omnipotent universal manipulation via the Infinity Stones.

sources.supports: Details Thanos with the Infinity Gauntlet and the effects of the snap.

notableResults.note: Used the Infinity Gauntlet to wipe out half of all life in the universe despite Thor's attack.

conditional.dependsOn: Holding the Infinity Gauntlet with the Infinity Stones

campaignTags.claim: Uses the Space Stone to teleport across locations.

unknowns: Full potential limits of the stones when used defensively.

characters.continuity: Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) - Alternate Future Variant
characters.summary: King Thanos is an older, battle-hardened ruler who has conquered reality and commands terrifying cosmic forces alongside captive entities.

mechanisms: Enhanced durability and experienced combat reflexes

weaknesses: Arrogance and psychological fixation on death
characters.formDifferences: Represents an aged, reigning tyrant variant with expanded cosmic resources.

sources.supports: References to alternative future versions of Thanos.

unknowns: Specific canonical feats for King Thanos are primarily derived from comic lore rather than primary MCU films.

characters.summary: The Ancient One is a supreme master of the mystic arts, utilizing intricate spells, dimensional weapons, astral projection, and mirror dimension manipulation to outmaneuver adversaries.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to fatal physical trauma if caught off guard or stripped of magical focus
limitations: Relies on gestures and focus to weave complex spells

sources.supports: Overview of the Ancient One's magical abilities and role as Sorcerer Supreme.

feats.claim: Punched Stephen Strange's astral form out of his physical body instantly.

notableResults.note: Easily demonstrated mystical superiority during Strange's initial training.

campaignTags.claim: Master of the Mystic Arts casting various eldritch spells.
Wields dimensional magic and mystic artifacts.

unknowns: Full extent of her power when drawing from the Dark Dimension.

characters.summary: The Wasp utilizes Pym Particle technology to shrink to microscopic size or grow, flying with synthetic insect wings and attacking with bio-electric stingers.

mechanisms: Extreme difficulty to target while shrunken

weaknesses: Vulnerable to physical attacks if caught while at normal size or if regulator fails
limitations: Relies on suit power and Pym particle gas supplies

sources.supports: Overview of Hope van Dyne's Wasp suit capabilities, flight, and bio-electric stings.

feats.claim: Navigated through complex security systems while shrunken and defeated multiple armed guards.

conditional.dependsOn: Wearing the Wasp suit and operating Pym particles

campaignTags.claim: Flies using mechanical wings integrated into the Wasp suit.
Shrinks and grows using Pym Particle technology.
Fires bio-electric energy blasts from wrist gauntlets.

unknowns: Maximum payload of carried objects while shrunk.

characters.summary: Uatu the Watcher observes all multiversal events with cosmic awareness, intervening selectively with immense cosmic power when existence itself is threatened.
weaknesses: Bound by an oath of non-interference except under extreme multiversal threats
limitations: Strictly constrained by his oath of observation

sources.supports: Overview of Uatu the Watcher's role and cosmic abilities in What If...?

feats.claim: Fought Ultron across multiple universes using cosmic energy blasts.

notableResults.note: Engaged in a vast multiversal battle before forming the Guardians of the Multiverse.

campaignTags.claim: Floats and flies naturally through space and dimensions.

unknowns: Full limits of his combat power when unconstrained.

characters.summary: Thena is an elite Eternal warrior who can manifest any weapon out of cosmic energy, engaging enemies with lethal grace and master-level martial arts.

mechanisms: Eternal physiology providing superhuman durability and fast reflexes

weaknesses: Suffers from 'Mahd Wy'ry', causing memory degradation and disorientation in combat
mobility: Superhuman running, leaping, and agile combat movement
limitations: Episodes of Mahd Wy'ry can temporarily incapacitate her focus

sources.supports: Details on Thena's warrior background, cosmic weapon manifestation, and condition.

feats.claim: Fought off hordes of Deviants single-handedly using materialized cosmic spears and swords.

campaignTags.claim: Manifests weapons out of pure cosmic energy.

unknowns: The absolute upper limit of her weapon durability.

characters.summary: Thor is the Asgardian God of Thunder, combining superhuman strength, flight via hammer or axe, and devastating lightning manipulation.

mechanisms: Resistance to extreme heat and electrical discharges

weaknesses: Vulnerable to bladed weapons of sufficient cosmic sharpness
limitations: Requires weapons for controlled sustained flight

sources.supports: Overview of Thor's Asgardian physiology, lightning powers, Mjolnir, and Stormbreaker.

feats.claim: Withstood the full force of a star's heat for minutes to forge Stormbreaker.
Cleared an army of Outriders with a massive lightning drop in Wakanda.

notableResults.note: Defeated when Thanos used the completed Infinity Gauntlet despite Thor striking him with Stormbreaker.

campaignTags.claim: Summons and manipulates lightning naturally and via weapons.
Flies by spinning Mjolnir or throwing Stormbreaker.
Summons the Bifrost bridge to travel across space.

unknowns: Exact output limits of his awakened thunder state without weapons.
